_doc: GENERATED by python3 -m foundation topology --emit-system from doctrine/topology.json. Do not edit; edit the topology. SYSTEM-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): the one running system as data; `python3 -m foundation system --render` writes one wrangler config per worker to instances/ultrastable/system/; `--check` fails when the rendered files drift, a service binding names no worker, or a queue has no consumer. deploy/deploy-system.mjs deploys workers from the same data and probes /agents/probe.
name: ultrastable

ultrastable-tick.role: heartbeat, executor dispatch, in-Worker code agents, lane, worker gate and handoffs (merge -> deploy -> probe -> close or roll back)

ultrastable-site.role: public site, read-only live record, agent surfaces (/mcp, discovery documents), control-plane API /api/v1 and /ops dashboard (reads ORG live)

ultrastable-dashboard.role: owner dashboard: e-mailed-code login, task queue, audit log, and a plain-English console agent (read-only until a fresh code; changes go through the audited command path); reached only through the site's OWNER service binding

ultrastable-agents.role: code agents (Workers AI adapters from doctrine/code-agents.json), probed live

ultrastable-tenants.role: tenant store (US-SPEC-25): per-tenant SQLite Durable Objects with free-plan budgets, vectors and rollups; /health runs a self-test the tick reads

ultrastable-unlearn.role: Unlearn tenant app (instances/unlearn): coaching moves for the adult beside a curious child; hourly beat re-learns move weights, measures, opens the next phase when its gates hold, prunes by retention
